{{Attr|Splash}} }} ==Description== The '''Evil Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. As a fast, high health enemy that often spawns in swarms, it poses more of a threat than compared to other duckies. It spawns with [[Aggro]] and [[Splash Damage Immunity]], meaning towers are forced to target it and it receives no damage from explosions. ==Logbook Description== "''Evil Ducky is the culmination of negative emotions after the portal was deactivated. Duckies burdened with malice and hatred slowly transformed into devilish ducks that cause mayhem wherever they waddle. Evil Duckies enjoy harassing the young ducklings, at least until Grandma Duck hits them with her cane.''" ==Appearance== The '''Evil Ducky''' is a devilish duck with a black body, orange flippers and beak, and red eyes. It also has red horns on its head. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a mischievous expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes partially closed, likely because it is scared. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *The '''Evil Ducky''' has the [[Splash Damage Immunity]], meaning towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] cannot damage it. **Due to it having [[Aggro]] and a lot of the stronger explosion towers having high range, it is very likely they will attack it and waste their shots. *Towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]] or [[Minigunner]] can be used to deal with this enemy. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1EvilDucky1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1EvilDucky2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1EvilDucky3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseEvilDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHunt2025PI4.png|'''Evil Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator Easter 2025 Event|'''Evil Ducky''' in the opening [[Bathroom Approach]] cutscene. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} EvilDuckyIconIG.png|'''Evil Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Evil Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' -
